newsitem.title: USA: Marquette Medical introduces RSVP system.
newsitem.headline: Marquette Medical introduces RSVP system.

text.p: Marquette Medical Systems Inc said Wednesday it introduced a new server application for its Unity patient monitoring network.
Remote System for Viewing Patients (RSVP) enables clinicians to use ordinary telephone lines and a personal computer to continuously monitor patient waveforms and vital signs within the facility.
Marquette said the system decreases time needed to assess patients.
Marquette manufactures medical electronics equipment, software and systems.
